layouts.name: Guadix
layouts.description: Draft association of the supplied venue-level entry to the existing independently mapped full course at Circuito de Guadix. This venue has one supplied entry and one retained independent course, with a timing point on that course. Source trace distance 2777.9 m; supplied distance 2697 m. The association preserves the independent source geometry and remains provisional where corner configurations or historical distances differ.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap course and venue identity
sources.evidenceNote: Venue identity and trace coordinates come from the pinned OSM extract. The source identity identifies the facility; course configuration is provisional. No privately sourced coordinates enter the public database.

sources.title: Reusable aerial imagery for estimated road borders
sources.evidenceNote: Derived edge coordinates; reusable imagery evidence: https://www.ign.es/resources/licencia/Condiciones_licenciaUso_IGN_eng.pdf. Image hashes, extents and extraction evidence are stored in the layout. Estimates remain unreviewed.
